statement: An employer must, when required by an assessor's notice, furnish a return of remuneration of persons employed (the annual employer's return, Form BIR56A with Forms IR56B), must notify the Commissioner of Inland Revenue in writing of the commencement of an employee who is or is likely to be chargeable to salaries tax not later than 3 months after the employment commences (Form IR56E), and must give notice not later than 1 month before an employee ceases to be employed in Hong Kong (Form IR56F) (Inland Revenue Ordinance section 52(2), (4) and (5)).
caveat: Hong Kong has no wage withholding for salaries tax; employees are assessed directly, so the employer's duties are informational. Section 52(6)-(7) adds the departing-employee regime (one month's notice of an employee leaving Hong Kong and withholding of payments pending tax clearance), and directors are deemed employees for this section.
